name: Liu Shaorong
profile: Listed by Hurun China (2021) with Ma Yongtao for WINBO-Dongjian (Guangdong Dongjian / 东箭科技, auto components, SZ:300978). Searches confirmed Ma Yongtao as Dongjian's chairman and controlling shareholder, but found no source naming Liu Shaorong (刘少容) or her role.
notes: Could not verify identity; company site dongjian.cc PDFs blocked by WAF. Ma Yongtao is chairman/actual controller of Dongjian per a 2023 company announcement (per search summary). Likely a family co-holder; route via company IR.

name: Fu Shan
current_role: Managing Partner, Vivo Capital; Chairman, VISEN Pharmaceuticals (since 2025)
profile: Former Chinese government official (NDRC, State Economic and Trade Commission, State Council offices) who became Blackstone's Beijing chief representative in 2008 and a Senior Managing Director in its private equity group. Joined Vivo Capital in 2013 as Managing Partner and Co-CEO, later CEO of Greater China; now chairs VISEN Pharmaceuticals and sits on biotech boards.
interesting_fact: In a Nov 2025 interview he said Vivo debated 'people versus assets' for two years and decided to back assets, running NewCos whose job is 'to develop its pipeline as fast and cheaply as possible.'
deep_cut_fact: He holds bachelor's and master's degrees in History from Peking University, an unusual background for a biotech investor.
notes: Before Blackstone he was VP of Beijing Mainstreets Investment Group (per globalcustodian/privateequitywire reports of Blackstone's Beijing office). Also on Esco Lifesciences board since May 2021. Best route: Vivo Capital.

name: Sun Jianhua
current_role: Founder, Chairman and General Manager (executive director), Sino Medical Sciences Technology (赛诺医疗, SSE STAR: 688108)
profile: Peking University-trained biochemist with a US PhD who founded Sino Medical in Tianjin in September 2007; the company makes interventional cardiovascular and neurovascular devices (e.g. drug-eluting stents) and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019. Re-elected chairman in June 2024; in May 2026 the company filed for a Hong Kong main-board listing.
interesting_fact: Sino Medical filed a Hong Kong main-board listing application on 27 May 2026 (sole sponsor CMB International), seeking a dual listing on top of its 2019 STAR Market debut.
deep_cut_fact: Before returning to China he earned a PhD in molecular biophysics from Florida State University (1992) and was technical director at US firm Terion Industries Inc. (1996-2000).
notes: Aged 64 per May 2026 HK filing coverage. Chairmanship confirmed by June 2024 board announcement (static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2024-06-07/1220288402.PDF). Best route: company IR / board secretary office.

name: Wu Xinli
current_role: Co-founder and largest individual shareholder (10.27% as of 31 Mar 2026), Shenzhen Longli Technology (隆利科技, SZ:300752)
profile: Wu Xinli co-founded Shenzhen Longli Technology in 2007. The company makes LED backlight display modules for phones, cars, industrial and medical displays and has worked on Mini LED since 2016. He shares the Hurun listing with Lv Xiaoxia, the company's legal representative and listed chairman. He is the largest individual shareholder.
interesting_fact: Longli started Mini LED R&D in 2016 and has filed 100+ Mini LED patent applications, including work on Mini LED backlights for VR headsets.
notes: Shareholding from quote.cfi.cn/gdtj/66303/300752.html. Sources conflict on his title: startupintros calls him founder/chairman/president, while 36kr lists Lv Xiaoxia (吕小霞) as chairman. Check the latest Longli annual report. Low public profile.

name: Li Jianghuai
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Leedarson IoT Technology (立达信物联科技, SSE: 605365), Xiamen
profile: Born 1975, Li Jianghuai is the controlling shareholder and co-actual controller (with Mi Li) of Leedarson. The Xiamen company grew out of Zhangzhou Leedarson Green Lighting, makes LED lighting, and expanded into smart-home and IoT devices. It listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in July 2021, and he remains chairman and GM.
interesting_fact: Leedarson started in lighting and used smart lighting as its entry point into IoT. It was formerly known as Xiamen Leedarson Lighting Group.
deep_cut_fact: Before running Leedarson he was chairman and GM of Zhangzhou Leedarson Green Lighting. In 2017 Xiamen picked him as a 'leading entrepreneurial talent' under its 'Double Hundred Plan' (双百计划), and he was nominated vice-chairman of the China Association of Lighting Industry.
notes: Hurun co-listing 'Mili' = Mi Li (米莉), named with him as actual controller in the 2021 IPO prospectus summary (China Securities Journal). Route via Leedarson IR / board secretary.

name: Jay C. Horgen
current_role: President and Chief Executive Officer and board member, Affiliated Managers Group (NYSE: AMG)
profile: Jay Horgen runs AMG, the asset-management firm that takes stakes in independent investment firms (its 'Affiliates'). He joined in 2007 and led new investments, served as CFO from 2011 to 2019, then became President and CEO in 2019. Before AMG he spent 1993-2005 as an asset-management investment banker at Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch.
interesting_fact: He became AMG's CEO in 2019, after serving as its CFO from 2011 to 2019.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining AMG in 2007 he founded his own private equity firm, Eastside Partners, and served as its Managing Director. He holds a Yale B.A. in Economics and Mathematics.

name: Liu Hujun
current_role: Founder of Shenzhen LianTronics / Liantronics (联建光电, SZ:300269); no longer chairman since March 2024
profile: Born 1970 with vocational-school (中专) education, Liu Hujun worked at several Shenzhen/Changsha electronics firms before starting an LED big-screen distribution business in 1997. He founded LianTronics in Shenzhen in 2003 and later moved it into outdoor LED advertising, including a 2013 acquisition of Fenshi Media. He stepped down as chairman in March 2024.
interesting_fact: For Lantern Festival/Valentine's Day 2014 he ran what was billed as the largest WeChat red-envelope campaign, giving more than RMB 300,000 to roughly 50,000 people in 500+ WeChat groups to promote LianTronics.
deep_cut_fact: To get around WeChat's per-account red-envelope limits for that 2014 campaign he set up 40 phone numbers, each tied to its own bank card. He said he watched the screen almost nonstop for four days, and called it 'a clumsy first step in the history of corporate WeChat marketing.'
notes: Bio and March 2024 departure from chairman role come from a user-contributed profile (m.maigoo.com/mingren/6805.html); verify against company filings. Hurun co-listing: Xiong Jinyu.

name: Yu Rongqing
current_role: Chairman, Suzhou Hengjiu Photoelectric Technology (恒久科技, SZ:002808); stepped down as general manager in January 2025
profile: Yu Rongqing is a PhD materials scientist (born November 1967). He worked at Mitsubishi before returning to China in 2002 to found Suzhou Hengjiu, which makes laser organic photoconductor (OPC) drums and toner cartridges for printers and copiers. He is the controlling shareholder (34.5% after a 2021 share transfer) and remains chairman.
interesting_fact: He is vice-chair of China's national copier-machinery standardization technical committee and has helped draft several national and industry standards.
deep_cut_fact: He studied chemistry at Xiamen University, where he took his bachelor's and master's degrees and then taught as a lecturer. He earned his PhD at the National University of Singapore and became chief engineer at Mitsubishi's information-electronics company before founding Hengjiu.
notes: Hurun co-listing Lan Shanying (兰山英) is a fellow Hengjiu director. Company currently trades as *ST Hengjiu and was subject to a 2025 CSRC disclosure-related penalty involving him; treat outreach sensitively. Route via the board secretary office.
